conventions.frame: wheel slot frame: metres, spin axis X, -X outboard on all four car wheels (E0.5); offset and scale are the prop localTransform position and visualScale [x, y, z]
conventions.scale: lip radius = min(stock rim outer radius, tyre bead radius + 0.0015) / rimBase.radius on Y and Z; X is the same on cars (uniform), the stock rim width / rimBase.width on motorcycles
conventions.offset: x = stock rim face x (after its visualScale) - scale.x * rimBase.face_x, so the new lip face is flush with the stock one; y = z = 0
conventions.hide: stock rim components of the player appearance on the four contract slots (never the tyre), plus rim centres on brake slots that reach into the new rim
conventions.slots: per-slot offset/scale where a wheel differs from the front-left (car) or front (bike) one; a client that ignores it puts the record-level fit on every wheel
conventions.extraSlots: wheels beyond the contract slots (Merrimac middle axle): slot -> offset, scale, hide; not covered by setWheels as specified
conventions.slotNames: motorcycles: contract slot -> the stock slot the stock rim binds to (the offset is measured in that frame)
conventions.rightSide: no extra turn: right slot frames are the left ones turned 180 deg about Z (so -X stays outboard), and the stock right rims use the left mesh unrotated or with a spin phase about X only (mountTable[].rightSide per model)
